name: A Letter to Grelin Whitebeard
summary: A letter from Ironforge reaches Grelin Whitebeard at his camp in Coldridge Valley. Its news and instructions bring the mountain capital close to the snowy frontier.

sections.title: A Dispatch from the Mountain
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard receives a dispatch from Ironforge at his camp in Coldridge Valley. Anvilmar offers shelter, but the valley lies far from its safety. Letters link scouts and scholars in the field with the halls of the mountain capital. This one has come south along the mountain paths to reach him.

faq.answer: Grelin Whitebeard is a dwarven scout and explorer camped in southeastern Coldridge Valley. Messengers from Anvilmar bring him news and instructions from Ironforge.

faq.q: Where did this letter come from?
faq.answer: The letter comes from Ironforge, the dwarven capital. A local postal courier carries it through Coldridge Valley and out to the field.

King Magni Bronzebeard sends Grelin a short note. With no time to spare, he gives Grelin authority to deal with the trolls as he sees fit, especially if Grelin can find a quick solution. Grelin welcomes the word; it has been a while since he last heard from Ironforge.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may carry dispatches across Dun Morogh’s freezing passes. Young mountaineers and recruits do so as a basic duty, hoping to make a name for themselves.
